name: Availability Check
summary: Date-range availability checks that count reportable receiving, dunnage, and Volvo data before generation begins, with quick presets for Yesterday, Today, and This Week plus full-day date boundaries.

userActions: Pick Yesterday, Today, or This Week from the quick range selector
Check which modules have reportable data before generating output
validationHints: Confirm Yesterday, Today, and This Week quick ranges populate the expected start and end dates
Confirm availability counts and enabled states still match the chosen date range
Confirm records created later on the selected end date are still included in availability results
